title: Benefit Litigation
description: Website for a law firm that resolves complex insurance disputes and protects its clients' rights.
infotext: Designed in Figma, built on Next.js, content managed in Directus.
company: For more than 10 years, Benefit Litigation has been resolving complex insurance disputes, representing medium-sized and large businesses in courts of every level.
problem: The second version of the firm's website, with a completely reworked style and brand concept. The rebrand followed a merger with PATENTUS, Arbitrazh.ru and Kitsing & Partners, which formed a group of law firms under the Big Fish Law brand.
mockups_description: A careful review of the firm's previous experience led to a modern brand concept. The proposed options combined dark and light palettes. I also designed a distinctive animation and a new way of presenting information.
result: The finished website matches the client's brief and presents the renewed brand effectively, reinforcing the firm's market positioning.
meta_title: Case study: website for the Benefit Litigation law firm
meta_description: Website for Benefit Litigation, a law firm that resolves complex insurance disputes and protects its clients' rights.
